content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

The transition to selling beats online using cryptocurrency is not just a trend; it’s a necessary evolution. Traditional payment platforms often impose high fees, like Gumroad’s 10% cut on every sale, which can erode your profits. By utilizing a sovereign commerce stack that integrates NOWPayments, you can significantly reduce transaction fees to just 0.5%. This shift not only maximizes your earnings but also gives you full ownership of your sales infrastructure, ensuring that you are not dependent on third-party services.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture for selling beats online with crypto payments relies on a combination of free and open-source tools. This often includes using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. The integration of these components allows for automatic payment verification and product delivery. This not only streamlines your operations but also ensures that you retain full control over your data and sales processes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically crafted for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are not viable options. If you’re a beat maker in Nigeria, Ghana, or Venezuela, for instance, this infrastructure empowers you to sell your music directly to your audience. By eliminating reliance on intermediaries, you can price your beats competitively while enjoying low transaction fees. This approach fosters a direct relationship with your customers, enhancing brand loyalty and repeat sales.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, maximizing your profit margins.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign commerce stack include a hosting platform, payment processor, backend logic, and a storage solution for your products. Using GitHub Pages for hosting ensures you have a reliable and free platform to showcase your beats. NOWPayments facilitates seamless transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies, minimizing fees and maximizing your income. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage order processing, while a service like Supabase or Google Sheets can be utilized for data storage, ensuring you have access to customer information without third-party control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, you can follow a straightforward process. First, set up your hosting account with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, integrate NOWPayments into your website for crypto transactions. Afterward, create a simple backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle orders. Finally, upload your beats to a cloud storage solution like Google Drive for easy access. By following these steps, you can launch your online beat store and start selling directly to your audience, all while maintaining control and minimizing fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign commerce stack. This setup allows you to integrate cryptocurrency payments through services like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than traditional platforms. This way, you can sell your digital products directly while avoiding high fees.
You retain full ownership of your sales data and infrastructure.

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers a comprehensive solution that includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to build your sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore the offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for immediate download.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
